-- Zero-pads a number in 0..99 to two digits.
pad2(n: int) -> str =
  pre n >= 0 and n < 100
  post out.char_count() == 2
  ex pad2(5) == "05"
  ex pad2(42) == "42"
  if n < 10
    "0\(n)"
  else
    "\(n)"

-- Formats seconds since the Unix epoch as UTC HH:MM:SS.
-- The time of day uses floor modulo 86400, so negative values wrap to the previous day.
stamp(ts: int) -> str =
  post out.char_count() == 8
  ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(-1) == "23:59:59"
  let day = ts % 86400
  let h = day // 3600
  let m = (day % 3600) // 60
  let s = day % 60
  "\(pad2(h)):\(pad2(m)):\(pad2(s))"
